items.title: St. Vincent Covers Yeah Yeah Yeahs At Gabriela Hearst’s Spring 2027 Runway Show
items.summary: St. Vincent was at Paris Fashion Week on Monday to provide a live soundtrack for Gabriela Hearst's spring 2027 collection, which was inspired by Afghan women’s textile traditions. Annie Clark's stripped down four-song set in the courtyard of the Petit Palais included three of her own tunes — it was bracketed by MASSEDUCTION singles "New York" and "Los Ageless" and featured "Violent Times" from 2024's All Born Screaming — but most notably, she covered the Yeah Yeah Yeahs. items.title: Beatport Launches Indie Tech Genre Category
items.summary: Beatport has launched indie tech, a standalone genre category with its own Top 100 chart, separating it from indie dance. Beatport has added indie tech to its store as a standalone genre, giving the heavier, club-focused strand of contemporary indie dance its own page and chart. The change separates two sounds that had shared a single Beatport category. Beatport says the decision followed outreach to artists and labels across indie dance and the wider electronic music community, who supported the split.
